panels.title: Controllers online now
panels.description: v1 card 69. Whitelisted controllers in the newest snapshot (network_snapshot.controllers_in_region).

targets.rawSql: SELECT controllers_in_region AS "Controllers" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Controllers online over time
panels.description: Screenshot-only chart (controllers online over time). Whitelisted controllers per snapshot, averaged into buckets that follow the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(observed_at, $__interval),
       avg(controllers_in_region) AS "Controllers"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Controllers online now (list)
panels.description: Archived v1 card 67 ('Who's online?'), rebuilt from the controller sessions seen in the last two snapshots. Frequency shown in MHz.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, name, cid, rank_group AS rating, frequency_mhz AS "Frequency (MHz)",
       logon_time AS "Logged on", hours_online AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_online_now
ORDER BY callsign

panels.title: Controllers logged on (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 115. Distinct controllers by rating group with more than 60 minutes online in total in the period. Observer and C2 ratings are left out, as in v1.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(sort, rank_group) AS (VALUES (2, 'S1'), (3, 'S2'), (4, 'S3'), (5, 'C1'), (7, 'C3'), (8, 'I1+')),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group, sum(duration_minutes) AS minutes
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY cid, rank_group
  HAVING sum(duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT r.rank_group, count(p.cid) AS controllers
FROM ranks r
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Controllers logged on each month, by rating group
panels.description: v1 card 116 (v1 query edited 18-10-2025: was the last 3 months as one bar chart, now month by month). For each calendar month (UTC), distinct controllers per rating group whose sessions that month total more than 60 minutes at that rating (as v1, a controller who changed rating inside a month is judged separately at each rating). Observer and C2 are not shown, as in v1. Starts at go-live (no backfill).

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_month,
         date_trunc('month', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_month
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
months AS (
  SELECT g.m AS month_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 month') AS g(m)
  WHERE b.first_month IS NOT NULL
),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT m.month_start, s.cid, s.rating
  FROM months m
  JOIN controller_session_ranked s
    ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.month_start
   AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.month_start + interval '1 month'
  GROUP BY m.month_start, s.cid, s.rating
  HAVING sum(s.duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT m.month_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S1')  AS "S1",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S2')  AS "S2",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S3')  AS "S3",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'C1')  AS "C1",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'C3')  AS "C3",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'I1+') AS "I1+"
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.month_start = m.month_start
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CTR and FSS controllers active (30 days to month end, monthly)
panels.description: v1 card 63 (v1 query edited 17-10-2025: monthly). For each calendar month (UTC), distinct controllers who started a CTR or FSS session of more than 60 minutes in the 30 days before the end of that month. The point is drawn at the start of the month. The latest month is partial. v1 hid months with no controllers; zeros are drawn here. Starts at go-live (no backfill).

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_month,
         date_trunc('month', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_month
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
months AS (
  SELECT g.m AS month_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 month') AS g(m)
  WHERE b.first_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.month_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.month_start + interval '1 month' - interval '30 days'
      AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.month_start + interval '1 month'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 60
      AND s.is_ctr_fss
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Controllers active (30 days to month end, monthly)
panels.description: v1 card 137 (v1 query edited 17-10-2025: monthly, minimum 30 minutes). For each calendar month (UTC), distinct controllers (any position) who started a session of more than 30 minutes in the 30 days before the end of that month. The point is drawn at the start of the month. The latest month is partial. v1 hid months with no controllers; zeros are drawn here. Starts at go-live (no backfill).

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_month,
         date_trunc('month', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_month
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
months AS (
  SELECT g.m AS month_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 month') AS g(m)
  WHERE b.first_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.month_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.month_start + interval '1 month' - interval '30 days'
      AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.month_start + interval '1 month'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 30
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 50 service providers (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 108. Controllers ranked by hours online. Changed from v1: the score is hours online only (v1 added 5 points per hour to aircraft handled, which depended on frequency matching).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS controller,
       round((sum(duration_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND duration_minutes > 0
GROUP BY cid
ORDER BY sum(duration_minutes) DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Controllers with the shortest average session (last 30 days)
panels.description: UNVERIFIED. Screenshot-only chart ('Which controllers have the shortest avg session duration?'). The 15 controllers with the lowest average session length; the minimum of 3 sessions is an assumption because the v1 SQL was not recovered.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS controller,
       round(avg(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average session (minutes)"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY cid
HAVING count(*) >= 3
ORDER BY avg(duration_minutes), cid
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top S1 service providers (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 144 (updated 22-09-2025). S1 controllers ranked by hours online over the last 30 days (UTC), top 50. Changed from v1: the score is hours online only. v1 ranked by 5 points per hour plus aircraft handled, and aircraft handled needs controller-to-flight matching, which ADR-002 puts out of scope; this follows the existing 'Top 50 service providers' panel (card 108). The window is a fixed 30 days to now (UTC), as v1, not the dashboard time picker. Only sessions that were at the stated rating count, as v1 (rating on the session).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(MAX(name)), 'Unknown') || ' (' || cid || ')' AS controller,
       ROUND(SUM(session_duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_summaries
WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
  AND session_duration_minutes > 0
  AND session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND rating = 2
GROUP BY cid
ORDER BY SUM(session_duration_minutes) DESC, cid
LIMIT 50

Changed from v1: the score is hours online only. v1 ranked by 5 points per hour plus aircraft handled, and aircraft handled needs controller-to-flight matching, which ADR-002 puts out of scope; this follows the existing 'Top 50 service providers' panel (card 108). The window is a fixed 30 days to now (UTC), as v1, not the dashboard time picker. Only sessions that were at the stated rating count, as v1 (rating on the session).

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Controllers with the longest median session (last 90 days)
panels.description: v1 card 153 (updated 02-10-2025; titled 'longest avg session duration' but v1 uses the MEDIAN session length in hours). The 15 controllers with the longest median session in the last 90 days (UTC), at least 3 sessions. The label shows the name, CID and highest rating seen, mapped as in v1 (observer and C2 show as Unknown). Reconnects within 5 minutes are one session in v3 (v1 counted them twice).

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid,
         name,
         CASE
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 2 THEN 'S1'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 3 THEN 'S2'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 4 THEN 'S3'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 5 THEN 'C1'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 7 THEN 'C3'
           WHEN MAX(rating) >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
           ELSE 'Unknown'
         END AS rating,
         ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY session_duration_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
  FROM controller_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
    AND name IS NOT NULL
    AND session_duration_minutes > 0
    AND session_start_time >= now() - interval '90 days'
  GROUP BY cid, name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  ORDER BY median_hours DESC, cid
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT name || ' (' || cid || ', ' || rating || ')' AS controller,
       median_hours AS "Median session (hours)"
FROM per_controller
ORDER BY median_hours DESC, cid

panels.title: Controllers with the shortest median session (last 90 days)
panels.description: v1 card 154 (updated 02-10-2025; titled 'shortest avg session duration' but v1 uses the MEDIAN in minutes; the v1 comment says 900 days but its code says 90, 90 is used). The 15 controllers with the shortest median session in the last 90 days (UTC), at least 3 sessions, named controllers only. Supersedes the unverified average-based panel above, which is left in place. Reconnects within 5 minutes are one session in v3.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid,
         name,
         MAX(rating) AS rating,
         ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY session_duration_minutes)::numeric, 2) AS median_minutes
  FROM controller_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
    AND name IS NOT NULL
    AND name <> ''
    AND session_duration_minutes > 0
    AND session_start_time >= now() - interval '90 days'
  GROUP BY cid, name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  ORDER BY median_minutes ASC, cid
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT name || ' (' || cid || ', rating ' || COALESCE(rating::text, '?') || ')' AS controller,
       median_minutes AS "Median session (minutes)"
FROM per_controller
ORDER BY median_minutes ASC, cid

panels.title: Controllers on for more than 4 hours in any 8-hour window
panels.description: v1 card 186 (updated 14-02-2026). Controllers whose sessions add up to more than 4 hours (240 minutes, strictly more) of wall-clock time inside some 8-hour window; ATIS callsigns excluded; where one controller has overlapping sessions the earlier one is cut off when the next starts, so no time is counted twice. One summary row per controller (their busiest window, UTC) followed by one detail row per session in that window. Changed from v1: only sessions starting inside the dashboard time range (plus 8 hours before it) are examined, and at most the 100 controllers with the most recent busiest window are listed; v1 scanned all time with no limit. Reconnects within 5 minutes are one session in v3, so the gap counts as time on.

targets.rawSql:
-- Controllers with more than 4 hours controlling in any 8-hour period (ATIS excluded, unique wall-clock time, UTC).
-- Where one cid has overlapping sessions, the earlier one is cut off at the start of the next so time is not counted twice.
WITH controller_sessions AS (
  SELECT cid,
         name,
         callsign,
         session_start_time AS s_start,
         COALESCE(session_end_time, session_start_time + session_duration_minutes * interval '1 minute') AS s_end
  FROM controller_summaries
  WHERE session_duration_minutes > 0
    AND session_start_time IS NOT NULL
    AND cid IS NOT NULL
    AND callsign NOT ILIKE '%ATIS%'
    AND session_start_time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '8 hours'
    AND session_start_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
-- Clip overlaps: end a session at the next later start of the same cid (v1 used a correlated subquery; the window gives the same answer)
controller_sessions_adjusted AS (
  SELECT cs.cid,
         cs.name,
         cs.callsign,
         cs.s_start,
         LEAST(
           cs.s_end,
           MIN(cs.s_start) OVER (
             PARTITION BY cs.cid ORDER BY cs.s_start
             RANGE BETWEEN interval '1 microsecond' FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
         ) AS s_end
  FROM controller_sessions cs
),
candidate_windows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cid, window_start
  FROM controller_sessions_adjusted,
  LATERAL (VALUES
    (s_start - interval '8 hours'),
    (s_start),
    (s_end - interval '8 hours')
  ) AS v(window_start)
),
events AS (
  SELECT cw.cid,
         cw.window_start,
         GREATEST(cs.s_start, cw.window_start) AS t,
         1 AS delta
  FROM candidate_windows cw
  JOIN controller_sessions_adjusted cs
    ON cs.cid = cw.cid
   AND cs.s_end > cw.window_start
   AND cs.s_start < cw.window_start + interval '8 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cw.cid,
         cw.window_start,
         LEAST(cs.s_end, cw.window_start + interval '8 hours') AS t,
         -1 AS delta
  FROM candidate_windows cw
  JOIN controller_sessions_adjusted cs
    ON cs.cid = cw.cid
   AND cs.s_end > cw.window_start
   AND cs.s_start < cw.window_start + interval '8 hours'
),
ordered_events AS (
  SELECT cid,
         window_start,
         t,
         delta,
         SUM(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY cid, window_start ORDER BY t, delta ASC) AS running,
         LEAD(t) OVER (PARTITION BY cid, window_start ORDER BY t, delta ASC) AS t_next
  FROM events
),
window_totals AS (
  SELECT cid,
         window_start,
         (window_start + interval '8 hours') AS window_end,
         (SUM(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (t_next - t)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE running > 0))::numeric(12,2) AS total_minutes
  FROM ordered_events
  WHERE t_next IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cid, window_start
  HAVING (SUM(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (t_next - t)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE running > 0)) > 240
),
-- The busiest window per cid (v1: DISTINCT ON, replaced by ROW_NUMBER; ties go to the earliest window).
-- Added: only the 100 controllers with the most recent busiest window are kept.
violations AS (
  SELECT cid, window_start, window_end, total_minutes
  FROM (
    SELECT wt.cid,
           wt.window_start,
           wt.window_end,
           wt.total_minutes,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wt.cid ORDER BY wt.total_minutes DESC, wt.window_start) AS rn
    FROM window_totals wt
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
  ORDER BY window_start DESC, cid
  LIMIT 100
),
summary_rows AS (
  SELECT v.cid,
         (SELECT MAX(cs.name) FROM controller_sessions cs WHERE cs.cid = v.cid) AS name,
         v.window_start AS period_start_utc,
         v.window_end AS period_end_utc,
         ROUND(v.total_minutes / 60.0, 2) AS hours_controlled_in_8_hr_period
  FROM violations v
),
session_rows AS (
  SELECT v.cid,
         cs.name,
         v.window_start AS period_start_utc,
         v.window_end AS period_end_utc,
         ROUND(v.total_minutes / 60.0, 2) AS hours_controlled_in_8_hr_period,
         cs.callsign AS session_callsign,
         cs.s_start AS session_start_utc,
         cs.s_end AS session_end_utc,
         ROUND(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (cs.s_end - cs.s_start)) / 3600.0, 2) AS session_hours
  FROM violations v
  JOIN controller_sessions_adjusted cs
    ON cs.cid = v.cid
   AND cs.s_end > v.window_start
   AND cs.s_start < v.window_end
)
SELECT row_type,
       cid,
       name,
       CASE WHEN row_type = 'summary' THEN period_start_utc END AS period_start_utc,
       CASE WHEN row_type = 'summary' THEN period_end_utc END AS period_end_utc,
       CASE WHEN row_type = 'summary' THEN hours_controlled_in_8_hr_period END AS hours_controlled_in_8_hr_period,
       session_callsign,
       session_start_utc,
       session_end_utc,
       session_hours
FROM (
  SELECT 'summary' AS row_type,
         cid,
         name,
         period_start_utc,
         period_end_utc,
         hours_controlled_in_8_hr_period,
         NULL::text AS session_callsign,
         NULL::timestamptz AS session_start_utc,
         NULL::timestamptz AS session_end_utc,
         NULL::numeric AS session_hours
  FROM summary_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'detail' AS row_type,
         cid,
         name,
         period_start_utc,
         period_end_utc,
         hours_controlled_in_8_hr_period,
         session_callsign,
         session_start_utc,
         session_end_utc,
         session_hours
  FROM session_rows
) sub
ORDER BY sub.period_start_utc DESC NULLS LAST, sub.cid, sub.row_type DESC, sub.session_start_utc NULLS FIRST
